statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The post-PCE price path is orderly and mid-range, so Tail falls back into the low band, while Stress stays elevated on a mildly firm data composition, the live cash open and the after-close NVIDIA report.
recommendation: Observed conditions are consistent with a resolved inflation checkpoint and orderly two-sided price discovery inside the overnight range. The opening auction, the 17:00 UTC 5-year auction and the after-close NVIDIA release are the evidence-based checkpoints at which the mapped state may change; the assessment is refreshed hourly.
headline: Post-PCE path stays mid-range and two-sided, pulling Tail back to the low band as the cash open begins
body: The 12:30 UTC release cluster has resolved and the observed reaction is orderly. Core PCE rose 0.2% MoM and held at 3.3% YoY, matching consensus on both measures, while headline PCE at 0.2% MoM and 3.7% YoY ran a tenth above forecast, durable goods orders jumped 1.1% against 0.5%, personal income rose 0.4% against 0.2%, and the Q2 GDP second estimate confirmed 1.5% in line. That composition is mildly firm rather than a shock, and the specific hawkish-surprise scenario flagged in earlier hours did not occur. The observed price path is the decisive evidence: NQ futures print near 29,161, about -0.39%, having traded 29,096-29,309.75 on the session, so the contract sits mid-band with the overnight low intact and both extremes already rejected. There is no directional efficiency, no chain of shallow pullbacks, no repeated extension after failed retracements and no session-extreme holding. Cross-assets do not align into a stress stack: VIX is 15.74 inside an unusually narrow 15.57-15.74 band, the 10-year yield is 4.658% after a 1.9 basis point drift within a 3.7 basis point range against the latest H.15 observations of 4.24% at two years and 4.70% at ten years, WTI is $80.67 and Brent $86.71 after a third consecutive decline on Iran-Oman Strait of Hormuz diplomacy, and delayed cross-asset context shows Treasury futures and volatility futures essentially unchanged with megacaps split four up and four down. Semiconductors and application software carry a mildly negative latest-session tone, which reduces directional conviction rather than amplifying Tail. Accessible delayed feeds stop at 13:16 UTC, so the 13:30 UTC opening auction itself is not yet observed; that specific gap is carried in Confidence, which stays high on the breadth of verified current levels, yields, oil, volatility and calendar actuals. Tail therefore returns to the low band and the mapped policy state is EA_ON. Stress remains elevated because the firm composition can still support a yield-led second leg, the cash session has only just opened, and NVIDIA reports after the 20:00 UTC close as the Jackson Hole symposium opens. The danger window is kept narrow around the opening auction and the first repricing minutes, and conditional Tail returns to the watch band later for the after-close report, where a delayed second leg through guidance is the specific structural concern.

lookbackSummary: The 24 previously published hours cover Tuesday's US afternoon through this morning's release cluster. Tail sat at 20 in the watch band at 13:00 UTC on 25 August, fell through the Tuesday cash session to 9-12 with a mixed then normal mode, and held at 11 for the entire overnight window, so the mapped state has been EA_ON continuously since 14:00 UTC on 25 August. Stress drifted from the mid-40s to 58 as the Wednesday cluster approached, and the 12:00 UTC hour lifted Tail to 16 on an event/whipsaw mode as the print resolved. Confidence held at 87-88 until that release hour, where it eased to 83.
outlookSummary: With the inflation binary resolved and the observed reaction orderly, the horizon is defined by the live cash open and the after-close AI report rather than by any trend. Conditional Tail stays in the low band through the opening hours, where opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would be the first genuine amplifier, then eases across the afternoon as the reaction is assumed to mature. It rises into the watch band for the 20:00-22:00 UTC NVIDIA release and guidance call, where a delayed second leg in thin post-close liquidity is the structural concern, and falls back to the low-band baseline overnight as Asian then European hours favour range formation. Confidence is modelled progressively lower across the horizon because that evidence is calendar structure rather than price path. Thursday's 12:30 UTC jobless claims closes the window, and the Warsh Jackson Hole keynote on Friday at 14:00 UTC, alongside the preliminary payrolls benchmark revision at the same instant, is the next high-impact checkpoint.
